description: Source code for Airtable document loader class implementing INode interface, including methods for loading data from Airtable API, handling pagination, and document creation.

classes.name: Airtable_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: Class implementing Airtable data loading as a node, with configuration for Airtable API access, document processing, and optional text splitting.

classes.name: AirtableLoader
classes.description: Class extending BaseDocumentLoader to fetch and paginate Airtable records, converting them into documents with metadata.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the loader with node data, fetches credentials, and loads documents, optionally splitting text and handling metadata.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads Airtable data, either all records or limited, based on configuration.

methods.name: fetchAirtableData
methods.description: Performs HTTP POST request to Airtable API with proper headers and error handling.

methods.name: createDocumentFromPage
methods.description: Creates a Document object from an Airtable record page, including URL metadata.

methods.name: loadLimit
methods.description: Loads a limited number of records from Airtable with pagination.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Loads all records from Airtable with pagination.
